items.title: THREE DAYS to go until edie’s Sustainable Supply Chains Summit
items.summary: Join us on 17 September for a unique opportunity to gain expert-led insights through thought leadership and industry panels featuring top professionals in sustainability, supply chain and procurement.

items.title: THIS WEEK: Preparing UK businesses for European sustainability reporting requirements
items.summary: Happening on Tuesday, edie’s new webinar will explore what the European Sustainability Reporting Standards for Third-Country Groups (ESRS-TC) could mean for UK-headquartered businesses.

items.title: NEXT WEEK: Practical actions to drive circularity across the business value chain
items.summary: Ina week's time, edie will hold its new webinar exploring how organisations can turn circular economy commitments into practical, measurable action across the business value chain.

items.title: SGC launches inaugural sustainability report as first Nigerian agric firm to adopt IFRS S1, S2 standards
Ocado expands ‘future of food’ aisle to promote sustainable brands
items.summary: Ocado has expanded its curated grocery aisle offering to support and spotlight brands that promote healthier and more sustainable food.

items.title: El Niño: Indonesia fire emissions in 2026 ‘on track’ to match record for this century
items.summary: Wildfires currently burning large swathes of land in Indonesia are on track to produce emissions on a par with the country’s most-intense fire season this century, according to experts.

items.title: TPE invests £1bn in battery trains amid push to decarbonise UK transport
items.summary: TransPennine Express (TPE) has confirmed that the £1bn investment will help to deliver Britain's first mainline battery-electric trains.

items.title: Factcheck: Reform UK’s 45 false or misleading claims about climate and energy
items.summary: Reform UK, led by Nigel Farage, has emerged as a major force in UK politics in recent years – pushing anti-net-zero policies, alongside vehement opposition to immigration.

items.title: 2026全球減碳浪潮下的台灣淨零現況
items.summary: 隨著全球氣候變遷加劇，各類極端氣候災害帶來的經濟與社會成本持續攀升。聯合國政府間氣候變化專門委員會（IPCC）在其核心報告中明確指出，人類活動產生的溫室氣體已造成全球平均升溫超過攝氏1度，氣候風險已不再是未來的預測，而是企業當前必須面對的實質成本。

items.title: AI淨零／ 環境部淨零綠領人才測驗成績公布 及格率6成
items.summary: 數位轉型已是產業進行式，人工智慧、淨零碳排更是政府與企業面對的兩大挑戰，攸關台灣未來競爭力。中央社第一線採訪團隊，深入報導政府與百工百業如何運用AI優化生產流程、驅動綠色創新，見證台灣產業再一次躍升。（中央社記者 吳欣紜 台北12日電）環境部推動淨零綠領人才培育課程，集中測驗日前落幕，環境部今天表示，成績公布，這次測驗整體平均成績為60分，及格率為6成，學員今天起可下載成績單等。
